en.bdb: The devotes live Dhruv et al.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਭਭੀਖਣੋ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਨਕ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhraoo prahilaadh bhabheekhano a(n)bareek bal janak vakhaanaa|

en.bdb: Dhru, Prahlad, Vibhisan, Ambris, Bali, Janak are well known personalities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੀ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: raaj kuaar hoi raajasee aasaa ba(n)dhee choj viddaanaa|

en.bdb: They all were princes, and hence the rajas game of hope and desire was always on them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਮਤਰੇਈ ਚੰਡਿਆ ਪੀਉ ਫੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਰਞਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhraoo matareiee cha(n)ddiaa peeau faR prahilaadh ran(j)aanaa|

en.bdb: Dhru was beaten up by his stepmother and Prahlad was caused to suffer by his father.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੇਦੁ ਭਭੀਖਣੁ ਲੰਕ ਲੈ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਲੈ ਚਕ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhedh bhabheekhan la(n)k lai a(n)bareek lai chakr lubhaanaa|

en.bdb: Vibhisan got Lanka by divulging the secrets of home and Ambris became happy seeing the Sudarsan chakr, as his protector (to save Ambris from the curse of Durvasa, Visnu had sent his chakr).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰ ਕੜਾਹੈ ਜਨਕ ਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਧਰਮ ਧਿਙਤਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: pair kaRaahai janak dhaa kar paakha(n)dd dharam dhin(g)taanaa|

en.bdb: Janak by keeping one leg into the soft bedding and another into the boiling cauldron showed his power of hathayoga and let down the real dharma.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: aap ganai viguchanaa dharageh paae maan nimaanaa|

en.bdb: The man who has eschewed his ego and has subsumed in the Lord is respected in the court of Lord.
Only Gurmukhs have attained the fruits of delight and only they are accepted (here and hereafter).
